title: export_logs params
description: Exports log entries to a file, one line per entry, with characters that are not printable, such as line breaks, escaped Go-style (\n, \u2028). The file is written as a new file that only the user can read (mode 0600) and then renamed to file_path, so it replaces whatever is there, a symbolic link included, without writing through it.

file_path.description: Filesystem path for the exported log file. Defaults to kamune-logs-<timestamp>.txt in the daemon's working directory.
